title: 28th October – Inaugurated Simulation Lab
summary: The Simulation Laboratory (Adult Health Nursing Lab) at Seva Mandal Education Society's Smt. Sunanda Pravin Gambhirchand Institute of Nursing and Paramedical Sciences, Matunga, was…
description:
The Simulation Laboratory (Adult Health Nursing Lab) at Seva Mandal Education Society's Smt. Sunanda Pravin Gambhirchand Institute of Nursing and Paramedical Sciences, Matunga, was inaugurated on 28th October 2026 by Rtn. Nikunj Jhaveri, Rtn PP Sanjiv Mehta, Rtn Yojit Gosalia and Rtn Parool Merchant in the presence of Seva Mandal Education Society's management, Principals of all Seva Mandal Education Society's colleges, the Vice Principal, and faculty members. The Lab was sponsored by President Rtn Nikunj Jhaveri and our Club at SMES Campus, Matunga. The Nursing College girl students will be able to get hands on practical training at the Simulation Lab. Beneficiaries 355 students per year.
Project cost Rs 14 lakhs
